verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Adyen Issuing purely in terms of balance-account-funded cards (single pool of funds or per-card balances, interchange revenue share) which is a prepaid/debit funding model — there is no mention of commercial credit or consumer credit line programs, credit underwriting, or revolving credit support. Without any documentation of credit-based card programs, the story's requirement for debit, prepaid, and both commercial/consumer credit types is not evidenced.
